ideas.pitch: A highly maneuverable, low-center-of-gravity 3kg combat robot built within the 350x350mm specification, featuring high-torque DC geared motors and an angled wedge design to leverage physics for ring domination.
ideas.title: TitanSumo 350
ideas.why_it_could_win: Since this is a physical Robo Sumo tournament with a knockout format, a reliable mechanical design with a low center of gravity and high torque will directly outmaneuver and push out less structurally stable opponents.

ideas.pitch: An RC sumo robot equipped with modular front-flippers and quick-swap tungsten-weighted wedge plates to rapidly adapt to different opponent configurations between matches.
ideas.title: Vanguard RC Edge
ideas.why_it_could_win: In a single-elimination knockout format, adaptability and mechanical durability are the most critical factors for surviving consecutive rounds against varied opponents.

ideas.pitch: An RC-controlled sumo robot featuring an onboard wide-angle camera feeding real-time positional telemetry to the pilot's controller screen via local Wi-Fi to optimize blind-spot awareness in the arena.
ideas.title: SumoTactician Pro
ideas.why_it_could_win: Most competitors rely purely on line-of-sight visual driving; adding a low-latency pilot-assist FPV feed gives a tactical edge in judging distance from the ring boundary.

ideas.pitch: A heavy-duty 3kg sumo bot utilizing custom high-grip rubber treads and dual-stage gearboxes to maximize friction against the volleyball court boundary surface, ensuring maximum pushing force.
ideas.title: IronClad Traction
ideas.why_it_could_win: In sumo wrestling matches, pushing power is a direct function of traction and weight distribution; maximizing grip within the 3kg limit wins matches.

ideas.pitch: An agile 350x350mm RC sumo robot featuring an active pneumatic-style or servo-actuated side skirt that expands upon button press to widen the pushing footprint just before contact.
ideas.title: Apex Shifter
ideas.why_it_could_win: Dynamic geometry catches opponents off guard by changing the effective blocking width instantly, matching the physical dominance criteria of the event.
